source.title: Town of Trumbull PlanningZones and OverlayZones (CT Metro COG, Trumbull_Parcels_NAD83 MapServer layers 7 and 6)

method: Sum of abs(Shape_Area) (state-plane feet squared, NAD83 CT State Plane, EPSG:2234 US survey feet; raw areas were negative on some features) grouped by Zone, queried without geometry; converted to acres via /43560. Base-zone total = 12655 acres (town land area is 14,786 acres, so about 2,100 acres of roads, water and unzoned land are not in the layer). MFO acres are from OverlayZones layer 6 (ZONECLASS MFOZ, two polygons, 39.9 + 10.3) and overlap the I-L/I-L2 base.

B-C LHGTHN.description: B-C Long Hill Green / Town Hall Node (Business/Residential)

MFO.description: Multi-Family Overlay Zone (overlay layer; overlaps I-L/I-L2, not additive to the total)
